name: agentsail
description: Customer-aware release gate harness for Agent Sail.
author: Agent Sail

commands.name: agentsail
commands.description: Dispatch Agent Sail collect, compile, check, verdict, report, and ci workflows.

commands.name: agentsail:init
commands.description: Install Agent Sail project harness files and YAML load-test template.

commands.name: agentsail:ci
commands.description: Run Agent Sail compile, check, verdict, and report.

commands.name: agentsail:compile
commands.description: Compile cached context into a customer release contract.

commands.name: agentsail:check
commands.description: Run Agent Sail checks against a target.

commands.name: agentsail:loadtest
commands.description: Generate or run YAML-driven Locust load tests.

commands.name: agentsail:report
commands.description: Render an Agent Sail HTML evidence report.

commands.name: agentsail:doctor
commands.description: Check Agent Sail CLI and project wiring.
